Use your bat to deflect the ball back on to the wall to gradually chip away and clear the screen to move to the next level.

216545.overview:
Fight your way through your roles as the Big Screen Hero to Hollywood, fame and fortune.

THIS is a collection of four old games, revamped and tagged with names and characters from classic films. Each game loads separately, and throughout each one the screen is surrounded by a border which gives you the impression of being in the audience.

Clint Bites the Dust casts you as the man himself taking cover behind an overturned waggon in a frantic battle with hordes of Indians who appear in the middle of the screen and move towards you, enlarging in a reasonable simulation of 3D perspective.

Your movements are limited to left and right as you try to avoid hurled tomahawks while shooting the redskins with your inexhaustible gun.

Frankenstein Meets Dr. Jekyl is a Pacman-type game where you play Dr. Jekyl trying to escape from several Frankenstein characters. Eerie music during pill collection and spine-chilling screams when you are cornered make this an atmospheric little number.

The Sawmill Massacre casts you in the role of heroic saviour. In the background a struggling girl is tied to a conveyor belt which inches inexorably towards a spinning and toothsome saw blade. On the right of the screen is the off switch, but between you and it is a hulk of a man who ain't gonna let you past without a fight.

Ginger Bones and the Caverns of Doom is a hunchback-style game with poisoned apples dropping on you, flying arrows at knee and head height, and gaps to swing over on uncatchable ropes.

216555.overview: British Super League is a football management game where you have to take a team from a choice of 16 teams and make them British Super League champions. The teams involved are a mixture from England and Scotland and each team plays each other twice. Your choice of options to influence the game are limited and they are the ability to change formation and positions of players, and to buy and sell play players in the transfer market. Once you are happy with your choices you then move to the next game. The whole pitch is viewed from above on the screen and you see yours and the oppositions players with a commentator saying which player has the ball. Players will flash in the area of the ball. A clock counts from 0 - 90 minutes and you are able to use two substitutes at any time during the game.

218605.overview: Throw your ball at identical balls and they will disappear. Easy!!!

218624.overview: This game is a ROM hack of Barbarian. There are 4 different scenario were fights take place. The game itself is the same, other than the backgrounds being modified

219906.overview:
Released exclusively as part of the Cascade 50 games collections (Cassette 50 and Disc 50).

Backgammon is a two-player game of contrary movement in which each player has fifteen pieces. The backgammon table pieces move along twenty-four 'points' according to the roll of two dice. The objective of the game is to move the fifteen pieces around the board and be first to bear off, i.e., remove them from the board. The achievement of this while the opponent is still a long way behind results in a triple win known as a backgammon, hence the name of the game.

219954.overview:
A variant of 'Breakout', this version doesn't require you to destroy all of the bricks, instead all you have to do is break your way through to the top of the screen to win.  The quicker you do so, the higher the bonus you receive before the next round kicks off.

Published in the pages of Amstrad Action Issue #009 (August 1986) as a type-in.

320088.overview:
A compilation of four titles from Ocean, three arcade conversions and a licenced adventure based on a super hero.

Games included were:

* Batman: The Caped Crusader
* R-Type
* Double Dragon
* Operation Wolf

417530.overview:
You are Kiloon - a part of Queen Kimbra's rebellion against the Kraag overlords.  Your task is to take out the hated King Arriel and break the stranglehold of the Kraags. But before you can do this you have to find Quillan, a Wizard who will help you in the quest and provide you with the magical weapons you need to fight your way to freedom.

A two part text adventure written in BASIC.

417540.overview:
The final part of the 'Adult' trilogy, 'Boredom' sees Baz try to cure his terminal boredom by seeking the path of true enlightenment and get into heaven.  Of course, if he just dies (based on previous behaviour), he's got no chance so he'll need to find another way in.

A text only adventure written with The Quill utility.

417552.overview:
Your attempted spying campaign has failed.  You've been captured and locked up in the stockade.  Starting off inside your prison cell, you must escape and then infiltrate 'The Base' to photograph the plans hidden in a secure safe.

A two part text only adventure.

417731.overview:
The circus has come to town, and like most children, the main character wants to run away and join it. So off he goes to see the ringmaster to ask him if he can join the circus. The Ringmaster says he'll consider it, but he gives you loads of tasks to do before he will accept you. So you find yourself running around playing throw-a-dart, hoopla and loads of other stuff.

A text adventure written with the GAC utility.

417761.overview:
Fly your plane across the screen and destroy the city below with your falling bombs.

One of the oldest games in existence gets an upgrade for the Amstrad CPC late in the machine's commercial life in this Amstrad Action covertape game. Given away with the June 1994 issue.

417767.overview:
While sanctioned by the War Federation, Dr Froglen recently broke ground in the development of neuro-viral life forms and the first 22 of these have been grown and transported under controlled conditoins to Federation Headquarters.  Their space ship never arrived.  You have been dispatched to the fifth planet of Zeta 23 to find the crashed ship and neutralise them.

A text only adventure written with the PAW utility.

425786.overview: Face your rival and cast the craziest spells to decrease their strength. Move around the platforms, go up and down the stairs sidestepping your opponent's spells. But be careful! Magic can have unexpected effects. Things won't always go as you'd wished... Be witched or be dead!

448430.overview: Submarine Captain Robinson goes deep into the Black Sea to search for treasures and discover all the secrets that those waters hold. The small bathyscaphe has a very limited oxygen deposit, so you will have to go to the nearby ports to recharge the cylinders. You must be careful not to disturb the inhabitants of the sea if you do not want to end up in the depths of the Black Sea.

450457.overview: Brick Rick thought it would be another normal day at work on the construction site, but instead it’s been invaded by aliens! Rick must stun all the aliens on each of the 50 stages, either by throwing bricks at them, or by pushing an alien that has already been stunned into them. There are several different types of alien; the walkers you’ll meet on the first few levels are fairly harmless, but you’ll soon encounter shooters, who are armed with laser blasters, and aliens flying around the screen in UFOs. You’re also up against the clock, and if you run out of time, a monster will appear and follow you around! This is a really nice little platform game with cute, colourful graphics and some very jolly tunes and jingles, and it’s great fun to play as well

450461.overview:
Jim the cabin boy wants to take advantage of the stay of his boat in Port Royal to fulfil his own plans for the future.

As bold as he likes, he is ready to keep the 125 pieces of treasure which are distributed by the galleon warehouses and flee as far as possible.

But the mission is not easy. The ship is full of pirates who watch the booty with strict discipline.

The rats are not on our side either, and the captain's parrot usually appears at the most inopportune moments.

Besides, the galleon's cellars make up a labyrinth of doors and rooms, where it is very easy to get lost or fall into the void.

450473.overview: This is a platform game based on the alter ego of a man who streams live on YouTube on Saturday nights testing his vast collection of Amstrad CPC cassettes. A fan was inspired to develop a game around this character (Novabug) and asked for help from other fans to provide graphics, level designs and music. You control Bug, and you must collect as many cassettes as possible so that the CPC community can watch more test episodes. If you lose a life, you will also lose a cassette. Getting to the Bug Loft will be no easy feat!

454360.overview:
Enter an unparalleled world thanks to BCM.  Your favorite games have been scattered into a thousand pieces of code.
It's up to you to collect these pieces and "recode" them in the correct order.

455401.overview: As a member of the International Anti-Terrorist Brigade, you must dismantle the GATO (Organized Terrorist Action Group)... Don't forget your weapon!

455402.overview: Defend your CPC against bugs attacking its circuit boards in this hybrid strategy/puzzle game!

456821.overview: ...... refreshed after a nice cup of coffee Professor Indiana Smith finally arrives in the vast and mysterious gardens of the palace of BABA-LIBA. All he has to do now is to get into the palace, rescue his friend Victor, unearth the treasure and kidnap the process before his time runs out. He'll need plenty of bombs and a lot of help to do it. Beware of crocodiles!!

461744.overview:
You, the bravest buccaneer, and your gang have been cruising the seas to assault the Spanish ships over years for wealth and glory. But there is no honour among pirates... Your crew has been kidnapped by Caribbean pirates and they have stolen all your treasures.

Now you take the way to rescue your comrades through two islands, eight stages and dozens of enemies to defeat...
